remarks: Elevated and framed by lush privacy hedging, this timeless coastal modern retreat offers three bedrooms, three-and-one-half baths, and stunning ocean, harbor and Catalina views from the rooftop deck. High ceilings and European oak hardwood floors establish a refined setting, complemented by Phillip Jeffries wall treatments, handmade American tile by Pratt  &  Larson, and designer lighting and window coverings. Expansive glass doors connect the sun-drenched front courtyard to a living room with a fireplace and mantel.
